title: File:Искусственный интеллект в обучении ординаторов кафедры педиатрии №2 Кубанского государственного медицинского университета.jpg
description: The photo shows the Multidisciplinary Accreditation and Simulation Center of the Kuban State Medical University, where residents of the Department of Pediatrics No. 2 analyze a situational clinical task on the BodyInteract virtual simulator, which is a horizontal touch screen table, which depicts a virtual patient and displays the data of physiological parameters requested during the diagnostics , electrocardiography, x-rays, the results of assigned laboratory tests. The virtual simulator in real time displays the change in the patient's condition, as well as all the manipulations performed by the residents, the patient's response to the treatment. At the end of the training session, an objective assessment of the student's actions according to the specified criteria is displayed on the screen. In particular, the expediency of the appointments made is indicated. This allows residents to practice basic clinical and communication skills not only with real patients, but also with artificial intelligence.
author: Lili.colin
